newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar, weaker on pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar, weaker on pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against the dollar but weakened on the pound on Wednesday, commercial bank dealers said.
The rupee traded at a mean commercial rate of 20.657 against the dollar from 20.662 on Tuesday. The rupee weakened to a mean of 32.3095 for one pound from 32.2895 on Tuesday.
Forex dealers said the central bank intervened in the interbank forex market on Wednesday mid-afternoon by selling dollars at a slightly lower rate than the prevailing interbank rate.

"It's the second intervention this week after the one of Monday. The market tends to be stable with the dollar's ask rate having stayed in the region of 20.80 rupees for quite sometime now," a dealer said. The dollar was quoted at the commercial indicative rate of 20.529/785 rupees on Wednesday.

The dealer added demand for hard currency by commercial banks' customers was getting less intense and inflow of foreign exchange receipts from the country's textiles exports was also helping to match demand and supply.
"There was an increased demand for foreign currency from importers who were entering in forward contracts. But this has cooled down now with the dollar trading in thin ranges," the dealer said.
